_comment: Version manifest — maps the G-Maiden app release to the logical version of each G-module. Hand-maintained lightweight SBOM. Bump a module's `ver` (SemVer) when its behavior changes; record app↔module mapping per release in `history`. See docs/architecture/versioning-policy.md.

versioning.rollback: roll forward — revert commits, ship higher app version; flag bad release as pre-release on GitHub

g-sentry.responsibility: Fog-of-war monitor — polls GSI/CV every 500ms; flags enemies missing >5s

g-signal.responsibility: Real-time gank warning — voice interrupt at >85% danger; hysteresis clear <50%; Belief Revision

g-motion.responsibility: Heatmap & path prediction — 5-min ring buffer of last-seen positions, gank route prediction
g-motion.note: Prediction params still tuning; OpenDota lane_pos priors + .dem trajectory training pending (see research/competitor-brightgir-opendota-analysis.md)

g-log.note: JSONL now; SQLite + probability calibration planned phase 6 (v0.9)

g-master.responsibility: Strategic/financial advisor — skill/item build advice vs enemy net worth & items
g-master.note: Currently Claude CLI w/ 30s throttle; Gemini integration planned (v0.7, phase 4). RAG pipeline pending — borrow 3-stage pattern from BrightGir.

g-damage.responsibility: Burst damage calculator — hero DB + armor/magic resistance formulas
g-damage.note: 8-hero database; actively expanding (3 feat commits). Hero attribute grid ref captured in research/assets/dota2-hud-reference.

g-voice.responsibility: Two-way voice — TTS output (done) + STT voice input (pending)
g-voice.note: TTS output side done (Piper Thai voice, phase 3/v0.6). Voice-input/STT half not started.

g-mind.responsibility: Cognitive router — routes requests Cloud/SLM/Template by latency & availability
g-mind.note: Routing scaffolding emerging in runtime.rs/slm.rs; full brain router pending.

g-memory.responsibility: Persistent memory — cross-match player/opponent memory (local only)

g-coach.responsibility: Post-match review — analyse decisions/outcomes after the game

g-persona.responsibility: Tone presets — persona filter (immutable Maiden core + selectable tone)

g-stream.responsibility: Streamer co-host — redact sensitive info, co-host mode

history.note: Initial manifest baseline. Seeded from AGENTS.md module status + git log scopes + src-tauri source files.
